briefHtml:
Portfolio Brief - Tue 2026-11-10 (SGT)

  • NAV: S$10,234,479, reported +0.42%; real day move approx +0.01% (S$+664 vs Monday's restated 10,233,815). Monday 9 Nov NAV restated up from 10,227,030 - level is authoritative, day-change is not.
  • Biggest mover on the tape: NVDA -4.27% (US$178.67) - the lone red giant on a best-since-April day - after its board opened an independent probe into Chinese-intelligence targeting of Jensen Huang via ex-Megaspeed (Singapore) executive Alice Huang. In the book, silver +1.6-2.2% to ~US$53 was the biggest positive driver.
  • The one thing: the war premium is deflating fast - Brent settled -5.8% at US$92.57 (WTI -4.4% at US$86.85) after Trump called fresh Iran strikes "highly unlikely" and the war "effectively over" post-Qatar-PM meeting; SPX +2.35% (best day since April), VIX -22% to 19.92. US CPI tonight 8:30pm SGT is the last gate input before the December FOMC. SGX was closed Monday (Deepavali in-lieu) and reopens today with a catch-up tailwind.

State and flags

  • riskFlags: ZERO - third consecutive clean snapshot.
  • L46.SI (Lum Chang): Yahoo 404, 29th consecutive session.
  • listedChgPct +2.46% mixes Friday Asia closes with Monday's US/metals rebound across the SGX holiday - directionally risk-on, not a live number.
  • FX: USDSGD 1.2787 (SGD firmest in weeks), USDCNY approx 6.66, HKDSGD 0.16304.

Position moves (Mon 9 Nov)

  • Singapore: CLOSED (Deepavali in-lieu). Last close Friday: STI 5,179.17 (-2.21%; -7.65% over the month).
  • HK: HSI 24,448.95 (-0.13%). SMIC HK$46.04 +1.01% - second session holding the HK$44-46 zone; Q3 earnings Thu 12 Nov. Xiaomi HK$30.10 (-0.92%); Tencent approx HK$417.8 (-0.5%).
  • US: SPX 7,549.94 +2.35%, Dow 52,389.75 +2.15% (+1,104), Nasdaq 25,253.14 +2.74%, Russell +3.15%; VIX 19.92 (-22.3%). SOX +6.9%: AMD +13.3%, AMAT +11.4%, LRCX +10.4%, AVGO +8.8%, MU +6.2%. NVDA -4.27% on the board probe; NVDA earnings 17 Nov.
  • Oil: Brent -5.8% to US$92.57 (lowest since late Aug), WTI -4.4% to US$86.85. Metals: silver approx US$52.8-53.1 (+1.6-2.2%), gold approx US$4,118-4,126 (+1.2-1.5%). 10y approx 4.88%.

Insider trades (7d)

  • Wing Tai (W05.SI): no new Form 1s since 4 Nov, but SGX was shut Monday - the cadence pause is only two trading sessions (5-6 Nov). Watch this week's reopen.
  • Other held SGX names (DBS, OCBC, UOB, Fraser and Neave, VICOM, Straits Trading, CDL, UOL, Yanlord, Ho Bee, Seatrium, YZJ, Singtel, Keppel REIT): none found. HK names (Tencent, SMIC, Xiaomi): none found. US ETFs (GDX, SILJ, SLVP, VNM): none by construction.

US Congress filings (new since yesterday)

  • House Republican (AK): SELL WDC $1k-15k (trade 15 Oct), filed 9 Nov - sold between the memory crash and Monday's +6% rebound.
  • Senate Republican (WV), filed 4 Nov, surfaced only now: SELL AAPL, META, MSFT, ZTS ($1k-15k each, trades 21 Oct) - big-tech sales a fortnight before the AI crash.
  • Yesterday's batch (NJ-5 AMAT/BHE/TLK; NVDA x2 + PG x2 buys + CSCO sell; PA-16 muni swap; OH-5 FMAO) covered in Monday's brief.

Trump / policy watch (24-48h)

  • Iran endgame: Trump met Qatar's PM, said the war is "effectively over"; Iran's president says the Supreme Leader ordered an end to the neither-war-nor-peace state. Tanker incidents continued at the margins (Dana Gas UAE, Aramco office debris, UKMTO Hormuz strike, burning tanker off Khasab).
  • NVDA probe: independent directors plus outside counsel; Gang of Eight briefed; Trump (briefed about a year ago, did not act) calls Huang "an honorable guy". Megaspeed (Singapore-based) is under a US Justice Department criminal inquiry; Singapore police probe still open. Watch export-control tightening on SEA cloud intermediaries.
  • Tonight: US CPI 8:30pm SGT - last gate input before the 8-9 Dec FOMC. Also NFIB, NY Fed Household Debt; Schmid and Paulson speak. Thu: jobless claims, AMAT and CSCO earnings. Fri: PPI.
  • Vol normalized: VIX 19.92 back in the 15-25 band; SPX best day since 8 April; market has retraced roughly half of Thursday's crash.
  • Metals firm despite hike pricing: silver approx US$53 (+~2%), gold approx US$4,120 - softer dollar and the post-blue-wave bid. Read-through to GDX/SILJ/SLVP and the IBKR silver line.
  • Singapore: SGX reopens today with a catch-up tailwind (US +2.35%, metals up, oil down) for the banks/industrials-heavy STI.

Risk

  • Watcher flags: none (3rd day).
  • IBKR silver line improving: at US$53.0 and 1.2787, collateral approx S$120,440; equity approx S$64,200 vs S$56,240 loan - approx 1.88x (1.91x Mon, 1.93x Fri, 1.77x 16 Oct). Each -4% silver day approx -7.5% of line equity.
  • Event risk tonight: hot CPI hits the duration gate, the AI complex and silver at once.
  • NVDA probe contagion into NVDA earnings 17 Nov and SMIC Q3 Thursday; Megaspeed Singapore nexus bears watching.
  • Iran two-tail: "effectively over" is a quote, not a deal; a breakdown re-inflates the oil premium funding this rally.
  • FX: approx 35% of net worth non-SGD; SGD re-firming (1.2787) is a quiet translation drag.
  • Concentration: STI -7.65% over the month into today's reopen.

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Defense/duration (TLT): 10y approx 4.88%, still approx 32bp below the 5.20% gate. Signal: CPI not hot tonight - deploy first tranche toward the 15% Defense target; hot CPI + Dec hike = stay parked (~62% of liquid book still idle cash).
  • Asia semis (SMIC 0981.HK): zone held (HK$46.04) but Q3 earnings Thu 12 Nov changes sizing math. Signal: staged entry only AFTER Thursday's print if HK$44-46 still holds - two event risks (CPI tonight, SMIC Thu) plus NVDA 17 Nov argue against lumping.
  • Silver (XAGUSD): line approx 1.88x and healing. Signal unchanged: ratio below ~1.7x AND spot above $55 before any Real-assets add; a deal-driven slide below $50 would be the better entry than chasing strength.

trumpWatch.title: Iran endgame: Trump says war 'effectively over' after Qatar PM meeting
trumpWatch.detail: Trump told CNN fresh strikes are 'highly unlikely' if talks progress, then met Qatar's PM Monday and declared the war effectively over; Iran's Pezeshkian says the Supreme Leader ordered an end to the neither-war-nor-peace state. Brent settled -5.8% at $92.57, WTI -4.4% at $86.85 - but tanker incidents continued (Dana Gas UAE hit, Aramco office debris, UKMTO Hormuz strike, burning tanker off Khasab).

trumpWatch.title: NVDA board opens independent probe into Chinese-intelligence targeting of Jensen Huang
trumpWatch.detail: Independent directors plus outside counsel are investigating reports the CEO was targeted via ex-Megaspeed executive Alice Huang; Huang admitted the affair in an employee memo ('I was unfaithful to my wife... no excuse'). Board sees no evidence secrets were compromised and backs Huang; Trump called him 'an honorable guy'. Megaspeed (Singapore-based) faces a US Justice criminal inquiry over chip diversion; NVDA -4.27% Monday, earnings 17 Nov.

trumpWatch.title: US CPI tonight is the last gate input before the December FOMC
trumpWatch.detail: CPI prints Tue 8:30pm SGT with a December hike already priced after Friday's +165k NFP. Also today: NFIB small-business optimism, NY Fed Q3 Household Debt; Fed's Schmid and Paulson speak. Thursday: jobless claims, existing home sales, AMAT and CSCO earnings; Friday: PPI.

trumpWatch.title: Vol regime normalized: VIX -22% to 19.92, SPX best day since April
trumpWatch.detail: SPX +2.35% to 7,549.94 (biggest one-day gain since 8 April, -3.44% from the 6 Oct record), Dow +2.15% (+1,104), Nasdaq +2.74%, Russell +3.15%. SOX +6.9%: AMD +13.3% (Oppenheimer upgrade), AMAT +11.4%, LRCX +10.4%, AVGO +8.8%, MU +6.2%. Roughly half of Thursday's crash retraced.

trumpWatch.title: Metals firm despite December-hike pricing
trumpWatch.detail: Silver approx $52.8-53.1 (+1.6-2.2%), gold approx $4,118-4,126 (+1.2-1.5%) as the dollar softened; gold/silver ratio approx 78. The post-blue-wave metals bid held through Friday's hot jobs report. Read-through to the GDX/SILJ/SLVP sleeve and the IBKR silver line (approx 1.88x).

trumpWatch.title: Singapore reopens after Deepavali with a catch-up tailwind
trumpWatch.detail: SGX was closed Monday 9 Nov (Deepavali in-lieu). It reopens Tuesday into a global risk-on tape: US +2.35%, metals up, oil -5.8% - net positive for the STI's banks/industrials mix after a -7.65% month. Local police confirm the Megaspeed investigation remains open, keeping Singapore in the chip-diversion story.

opportunities.thesis: Defense/long-duration sleeve: 10y approx 4.88% is still ~32bp below the 5.20% gate; gridlock plus a deflating oil war premium relieves term premium, but tonight's CPI is the decision input with a December hike already priced.
opportunities.signal: If tonight's US CPI does not accelerate, deploy a first tranche toward the 15% Defense target; a hot CPI with the hike ahead = stay parked (~62% of the liquid book still idle cash).

opportunities.thesis: Asia semis: SMIC held the HK$44-46 zone a second session (HK$46.04, +1.01%) with Q3 earnings now on Thursday 12 Nov (guide: revenue +2-4% q/q, GM 26-28%; 'AI spillover' demand commentary) - and the NVDA probe adds fresh headline risk to the AI complex.
opportunities.signal: Staged entry only AFTER Thursday's print if the zone still holds; do not lump in front of two event risks (CPI tonight, SMIC Thu) with NVDA earnings 17 Nov behind them.

opportunities.thesis: Silver: IBKR line approx 1.88x and healing as spot rebuilds toward $53; an Iran deal could deflate the war premium the way it has in oil.
opportunities.signal: Unchanged: ratio below ~1.7x AND spot above $55 before any Real-assets add; a deal-driven slide toward under-$50 would be the better entry than chasing strength.
